items.raw_excerpt: Bons Sons is a Portuguese music festival that takes place in the small village of Cem Soldos, near Tomar, and is famous for turning the entire village into a celebration.
items.summary_en: Bons Sons is a music festival held in Cem Soldos, a small village near Tomar, Portugal. It is famous for turning the whole village into one big celebration. The festival started its first day with music and fun.

items.raw_excerpt: Despite the sombre nature of funerals, Kathie Hicks says the buzz was loud at Carnell’s Funeral Home on Aug. 5 — exactly how John Cook would have wanted it.
items.summary_en: At Carnell's Funeral Home on Aug. 5, the mood was loud and full of life, just as John Cook would have wanted it. Friends remember him as a pioneer of St. John's nightlife. They called him the 'King of the good times.'
items.summary_ko: 8월 5일 카넬 장례식장에서는 장례식답지 않게 분위기가 시끌벅적했다고 캐시 힉스가 전했다. 바로 존 쿡이 바랐을 방식이다. 지인들은 그를 세인트존스 밤문화의 개척자로 기억하며 '좋은 시절의 왕'이라 불렀다.
items.title_en: Remembering John (Bull) Cook, a pioneer of St. John's nightlife

items.raw_excerpt: The naturist beaches reveal the wildest and most untouched side of the Algarve.
items.summary_en: The Algarve has many hidden cliffs and beaches. Naturist beaches there show the wildest and most untouched side of the region. Visitors can find quiet spots away from the crowds.
items.summary_ko: 알가르베에는 숨겨진 절벽과 해변이 많습니다. 누디스트 해변에서는 이 지역에서 가장 거칠고 사람의 손이 거의 닿지 않은 자연의 모습을 볼 수 있습니다. 방문객들은 인파가 몰리지 않는 한적한 장소를 찾을 수 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Government to spend Rs 3.5 crore annually; GSWMC to carry out daily collection
items.summary_en: Saligao and Pilerne are the first villages in Goa to get state-funded daily waste collection. The government will spend Rs 3.5 crore every year on it. The state waste company will do the daily collection.
items.summary_ko: Saligao와 Pilerne은 고아주에서 처음으로 정부 지원으로 매일 쓰레기 수거를 받는 마을이 되었습니다. 정부는 이 사업에 매년 3500만 루피를 쓸 예정입니다. 주정부 쓰레기 관리 회사가 매일 수거를 맡습니다.
items.title_en: Two Goa villages get daily waste collection

items.raw_excerpt: France's annual Nuits des Étoiles (Starry night) returns starting Friday, August 7th to Sunday, August 9th, with more than 600 free events taking place across the country.
items.summary_en: France's yearly star-watching festival returns from Friday August 7 to Sunday August 9. More than 600 free events will take place across the country. People can watch the night sky together at these local events.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스의 연례 별 보기 축제인 별들의 밤이 8월 7일 금요일부터 8월 9일 일요일까지 열립니다. 전국에서 600개가 넘는 무료 행사가 열립니다. 사람들은 동네 행사에 모여 함께 밤하늘을 볼 수 있습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: The 25 de Abril Bridge celebrated its 60th anniversary on 6 August, marking six decades since it first connected Lisbon with Almada and changed the way people travelled across the Tagus.
items.summary_en: The 25 de Abril Bridge turned 60 years old on 6 August. It first connected Lisbon with Almada and changed how people crossed the Tagus river.
items.summary_ko: 4월 25일 다리가 8월 6일로 개통 60주년을 맞았습니다. 이 다리는 처음으로 리스본과 알마다를 이어 주며 타구스강을 건너는 방식을 바꿨습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: A może tak rzucić wszystko i wyjechać... na Podlasie? Sołtys malowniczej wsi zaprasza spragnionych 'życia na łonie natury', by zamieszkali w jego wiosce. Na zachętę oferuje część swojej działki i pracę.
items.summary_en: A village head in Podlasie, Poland invites people to come live in his village. He wants to help people who long for life in nature. He offers part of his land and a job as an incentive.
items.summary_ko: 폴란드 포들라셰의 한 마을 이장이 자연 속 생활을 갈망하는 사람들을 마을로 초대했다. 그는 자신의 땅 일부와 일자리를 함께 제안한다. 지친 일상을 버리고 떠나고 싶은 사람들을 위한 부담 없는 제안이다.
items.title_en: A village head in Podlasie invites people to move to his village. He offers land and a job to newcomers.
items.title_ko: 폴란드 포들라셰 마을 이장, 자연 속 삶 원하는 사람 초대… 땅 1000㎡와 일자리 제안
items.title_original: Sołtys z Podlasia zaprasza na wieś. Wydzierżawi 1000 m2 za 100 zł. Ma warunek - Next Gazeta.pl

items.raw_excerpt: The singles tax has nothing to do with the ATO, it's the extra people pay when they can't split costs like rent, internet, insurance and other household bills the way couples can.
items.summary_en: The singles tax is not a government charge. It is the extra money people pay when they cannot split bills like rent and insurance. Couples can share costs, but single people pay the full amount.
items.summary_ko: 싱글 세금은 정부 세금이 아닙니다. 월세나 보험 같은 생활비를 나눠 내지 못할 때 혼자 더 많이 부담하게 되는 비용을 뜻합니다. 연인은 비용을 나눠 내지만 혼자 사는 사람은 전액을 내야 합니다.
items.title_en: How to avoid the singles tax without finding a romantic partner
items.title_ko: 연인을 찾지 않고 싱글 세금을 피하는 방법
items.title_original: How to avoid the singles tax without finding a romantic partner

items.raw_excerpt: Calgary couple's return journey from San Francisco was so chaotic due to the WestJet strike that they got home three days late — and missed their youngest's second birthday because of it.
items.summary_en: A Calgary couple was returning home from San Francisco. A WestJet strike delayed their trip by three days. They arrived home late and missed their youngest child's second birthday.
items.summary_ko: 캘거리 부부가 샌프란시스코에서 돌아오는 길에 웨스트젯 파업을 만났다. 항공편이 사흘 지연되면서 집에 도착한 것이 늦어졌다. 그 바람에 막내 아이의 두 번째 생일을 함께하지 못했다.
items.title_en: WestJet strike makes Calgary parents miss their child's second birthday.

items.raw_excerpt: As concentrated multiplexes offer fewer choices and streaming turns movie-watching into a solitary habit, Argentine cinephiles are rediscovering the communal experience of watching films together
items.summary_en: Streaming makes movie-watching a lonely habit, and big cinemas offer fewer choices. In Buenos Aires, film lovers are turning to film clubs to watch movies together again. These clubs bring back the shared joy of watching films in a crowd.
items.summary_ko: 스트리밍이 영화 보기를 혼자 즐기는 취미로 만들고, 대형 영화관도 선택지를 줄이자 영화 팬들이 다시 모여서 보는 방식을 찾고 있다. 부에노스아이레스의 영화 클럽은 많은 사람이 함께 영화를 감상하는 공동체 경험을 되살리고 있다.
items.title_en: Buenos Aires film clubs bring back shared movie nights

items.title_original: Buenos Aires film clubs offer an antidote to the algorithm

items.raw_excerpt: Clifton farmer Sandra Campbell tries not to take life too seriously, so there was room to experiment when she began planting the gullies on her dairy farm with native shrubs.
items.summary_en: Clifton farmer Sandra Campbell is filling the gullies on her dairy farm with native shrubs. She runs three small native plant nurseries and keeps a fridge full of seeds. She likes to keep a light-hearted approach to farming.
items.summary_ko: 클리프턴의 농부 샌드라 캠벨은 젖소 농장의 골짜기에 자생 관목을 심고 있다. 그녀는 자생 묘목장 세 곳을 운영하며 씨앗으로 가득 찬 냉장고를 보관한다. 농장 일을 너무 진지하게 받아들이지 않으려는 태도를 유지한다.
items.title_en: Farmer plants native shrubs in her farm gullies

items.raw_excerpt: Aspiring legal practitioners say this competition comes in handy when they start in legal practise.
items.summary_en: A university in South Africa launched a new law competition. It is called the Madlanga International Moot Court competition. Students said this contest helps them when they start working as lawyers.

items.raw_excerpt: The way forward for Wellington councils remains unclear, despite agreeing to submit amalgamation proposals to ministers this weekend.
items.summary_en: Wellington councils agreed to send merger proposals to ministers this weekend. But the way forward is still unclear. They do not know yet what will happen to local government in the area.

items.raw_excerpt: There are very few places on Earth that remain untouched and unseen by humans. For true explorers, the final frontier is not a distant speck in the sky, it is the underground realm beneath our feet.
items.summary_en: Explorers in Buchan, Victoria discovered a hidden cave. Very few people have ever seen it. The number of people who have seen it is smaller than the number of people who have walked on the moon.
items.summary_ko: 빅토리아주 부찬에서 탐험가들이 숨겨진 동굴을 발견했다. 이 동굴을 본 사람은 아주 드물다. 달에 발을 디딘 사람보다 더 적은 사람만이 이 동굴을 보았다.

items.raw_excerpt: El piloto chileno sufrió una fractura en la escápula izquierda hace una semana, pero estará presente en la séptima y octava fecha del campeonato este 8 y 9 de agosto en el Parque Las Palmas.
items.summary_en: Chilean rider Benjamin Herrera broke his left shoulder blade one week ago. He will still race in the seventh and eighth rounds of the National Enduro Championship on August 8 and 9 at Parque Las Palmas. He wants to keep his unbeaten lead in the title fight.
items.summary_ko: 칠레의 라이더 벤하민 에레라는 일주일 전 왼쪽 어깨뼈가 부러졌다. 하지만 그는 8월 8일과 9일에 라스 팔마스 공원에서 열리는 전국 엔듀로 챔피언십 7차전과 8차전에 출전할 예정이다. 무패 선두를 지키기 위해서다.
items.title_en: Injured rider will race to defend his unbeaten lead in Chile

items.title_original: Benjamín Herrera competirá lesionado para defender liderato invicto del Nacional de Enduro

items.raw_excerpt: Com apenas 31 mil habitantes, Porto Belo, em Santa Catarina, vendeu 2.850 imóveis em seis meses, movimentando R 2,5 bilhões....
items.summary_en: Porto Belo is a small city in Santa Catarina with only 31,000 people. In six months, it sold 2,850 properties worth R$2.5 billion. The numbers show how busy the local property market has become.
items.summary_ko: 포르투 벨루는 산타카타리나주에 있는 인구 약 3만 1천 명의 작은 도시입니다. 이 도시는 6개월 동안 2850채의 부동산을 팔아 총 25억 헤알 규모의 거래를 올렸습니다. 작은 도시의 부동산 시장이 얼마나 활기를 띠는지 보여줍니다.

items.raw_excerpt: Uma associação começou a medir diariamente a qualidade do ar numa aldeia do concelho de Ferreira do Alentejo, no distrito de Beja, afetada pela alegada poluição de uma fábrica e promete enviar os resultados para as entidades públicas.
items.summary_en: An association started measuring air quality every day in a village in Ferreira do Alentejo. The village suffers from pollution that may come from a local factory. The group promises to send the results to public authorities.

items.title_en: Association measures air quality in village hit by factory pollution

items.summary_en: Winds of up to 90 km/h are expected in Rio in the next few hours. The football federation and the clubs postponed the match that would open round 15. The game was moved to Monday at the Nilton Santos stadium.
items.summary_ko: 앞으로 몇 시간 안에 시속 90km에 이르는 강한 바람이 불 것이라는 예보 때문에 축구협회와 구단들이 15라운드 개막전 연기를 결정했습니다. 이 경기는 월요일로 미뤄져 니우통 산투스 경기장에서 열립니다.
items.title_en: Strong wind in Rio delays Botafogo vs Fluminense women's match
